assign.outcome:
**Promoted `.cols.half` and `.cols.main-aside` into framework.css**, beside the flex words, with the lab's exact mechanics (percentage basis, grow-by-weight, rem floor, the max/stack trick) and a one-comment pointer to the lab's doc. cols.css deletes its own copies of just those two; the other four words stay lab-local.

Migrated 4 of 6 call sites: DesignTool `.dt-case`, AITask `.ai-columns` (rail reordered + `order:-1`), lew42 theme's 2 sidebar demos (same reorder), and home page's Hero/Philosophy/Contact rows. All verified pixel-identical-or-better at 400/1920/3440 against a HEAD worktree baseline.

Resisted 2: `public/styles.css`'s `.home-front` (a 5-region row-spanning grid, not a flat 2/3-item row) and `ext/toc/toc.css` (unbounded children on one side, and `toc()` is DOM-first while `main-aside` wants main-first). apidoc/page.js's own rail also left alone — its own prior-fix comment argues against exactly the fixed/share basis `main-aside` would impose.

Cols matrix self-measure holds exactly (`main-aside`: want 2.125 got 2.125; `half`: want 1.000 got 1.000), both stack correctly below 34rem. Zero new console errors on a 10-url sweep.
